Made of PP #5 plastic which is supposed to be better than other kinds of plastic but all plastic will leach chemicals. I had ordered 4 sets (10 per package) but one jar and lid were missing from one of the packages, otherwise I would have given it five stars. reviews.t: Perfect for DIY skincare and travel containers
reviews.x: I recently delved into the world of DIY skin care products and these are perfect for storage.  The lids are completely secure so no leaking,  and the inside edges are rounded making it easy to get the last of the product out. They are also great travel containers for lotions. I couldn't be happier with this purchase!

these jars with lid are very good for whatever needs you may have. I used mine for salves of coconut oil, shea butter, olive oil, beeswax, and essential oils. I"d say high quality for being plastic.  Susan Pharis

I think depends what you do with the jar, you may find it good or not. The plastic is very thick and heavy, which I think it's very good in the long run and for storage. However, I ordered these for travel, so I can use it for my lotion. It is overall too bulky and heavy for traveling purpose.

reviews.t: Just what I was looking for
reviews.x: Love these and they are perfect for packaging my whipped shea butter. They don't leak (with thick custards... couldn't say for actual legit liquids). However, I have found a way to order them in mass for much cheaper per unit. Instead of nearly a dollar per unit I will buy them in mass from elsewhere for like 17 cents per unit. Sorry. I was having to charge so damn much for my products because these were just so pricey and I know it doesn't cost anywhere close to a dollar to make thee teeny jars

reviews.t: Wrong size - not as pictured or described
reviews.x: I ordered these containers based on the photos and the measurements given by other customers.  I was surprised to receive jars of a different shape.  Instead of fairly short and wide, they are tall and narrow, i.e. 1 inch in diameter and 2 1/2 inches tall. I was planning to use them for salves and ointments, but they are too narrow be be easily used that way.  Definitely a disappointment and, for my purposes, a waste of money.  Not worth returning, so I'll put them to use storing pins, nails, et

reviews.t: Perfect for lip balms, salves, and anything else you can dream up.
reviews.x: The jars were the perfect size for making salves and lip balms for gifts. The containers are solid white and did not leak at all. They are a smooth plastic so it is very easy to print your own labels and apply without much fuss. These are made of a pretty high quality plastic that would be easy to clean out, sanitize and re-use for the ultimate eco- friendly products.

Was very please with yours. I use them to hold lip sugar scrub and I've had no problems. They have a tight seal and stack well. They're also made out of really think plastic and so they're very sturdy and it's actually difficult to bend them. The jar and lid is white and you cannot see through it. I have no complaints.
Good and sturdy, good quality. No worries about breakage when dropped or filled with hot liquids. Will definitely buy again.
Same as the blue cobalt blue glass jar.  Useful for ointment, salve, and as container for you skin care product on travel.

I was happy to find these jars to hold my homemade cosmetic and hair care recipes.  Since the products are natural, I didn't want a large jar that would take forever to use up.  The size of these jars are perfect for my use.  The company shipped extremely quickly and packaged them in a clear plastic baggie (simple and no nonsense-just the way I like it).  I will buy from M Jacobs and Sons again.  I saw a few other sized jars that were fancier that I may utilize in the near future.  Browse their

Using these jars to make my own travel size products.  These are perfect for facial products in that require light blocking packaging, i.e., benzoyl peroxide.  I was surprised at how large 1-oz is...for a 5 day trip, probably only needed the .50 oz size.  I prefer these over gotubes...easier to clean out and store in the shower, especially when there are 3 of us, using several different products when showering.  I use a sharpie to label the lids.

reviews.t: These work just like you hope they would with the bonus of being ...
reviews.x: These work just like you hope they would with the bonus of being very well constructed; it's so satisfying every time I screw the lid on. I haven't tested any of them for leaking yet, but as containers that sit around on my counter, and were cheap, they cannot be beat.

reviews.t: These are NOT as pictured and the company does not ...
reviews.x: These are NOT as pictured and the company does not do returns.  These are tall and skinny - not suitable for ointment at all.  It was my second order from them, and both are different that what is pictured.

reviews.t: The lids on these jars so not thread easily and tend to leak as a result
reviews.x: The lids on these jars so not thread easily and tend to leak as a result.  Not ideal for condiment containers for kids lunches which is why I purchased them.  Will be looking for something else....
Husband uses these to portion out his daily allotment of herbal medicine. They are inexpensive, easy to open yet seal well, hold up to storing in the freezer, and are discrete. Perfect.
These little jars where exactly what I needed. Customer Service was great !!! they were prompt and courteous. I will continue to use M. Jacobs & sons for my jars.
As other reviewers have stated, images are incorrect. Bottle is actually tall and narrow, not good for putting homemade ointments in! Returned and refunded.
These jars are very similar to the ones I use in pharmacy when making ointments or creams.  I would recommend them if you are looking for just a few.
Perfect for little storage containers and for a great price! Would recommend!! check the size that you want because they have several.

reviews.t: Wow, much bigger than I pictured
reviews.x: These do not look like the jars I received.  The ones I received were rounded jars with rounde lids.  Not a deal breaker, but they were also much larger than I had anticipated.  I originally wanted something large enough to carry body butter in my purse.  I wanted it to be larger than the really small lip balm containers, but not as big as what I received.  I wanted something that looks like the size of this jar on my screen.  I'd say, twice the size of an eye shadow jar (l'oreal hip eye shodow)

While they hold the indicated volume, they're nothing like what's pictured. I didn't want something that looked like a cosmetic container, which is why I chose these, only to receive what are clearly cosmetic containers. Frustrating.  With that said, though, they're made well, seal completely, and work as advertised. (Note: the attached picture shows the lid slightly unscrewed, to make the seam more visible. With the lid completely screwed, the jar is fully sealed.)

reviews.t: Decent jars, wish price was a little lower
reviews.x: The price on all these small plastic containers is higher than I would like.  It seems like something like this should be available for more like 25 cents a piece, not $1 a piece.  Still, I suppose it's a small batch so it's not unreasonable you have to pay more.  I use these jars to package my homemade body butter and it works great.  Good fit and finish.

reviews.t: Perfect size for face masks or moisturizers
reviews.x: I ordered these 1oz pots to store a DIY charcoal face mask recipe I tried.  They are the perfect size.  I ended up gifting one to my sister and several friends for Christmas.  The quality of these little pots is great.  Thick walls, the lid screws on and off easily, and you can reach the bottom with ease.  Great for my purpose!

reviews.t: Totally do not recommend for anything liquid
reviews.x: I used this to give a sample of a liquid laundry detergent.  Put it in a package of other samples.  Leaked all over everything in my sample bags and ruined everything.  Lost my money on this, and the other things that were ruined.  Totally do not recommend for anything liquid.

claims.text: Many reviewers find these jars sturdy, well-made, and high quality for plastic.
Reviewers commonly use them for DIY skincare, salves, lip balms, and travel containers.
Several reviewers report the lids seal securely without leaking, though a few experienced leaking or difficult threading.
Some reviewers received jars that were tall and narrow rather than the short, wide shape pictured or described.
A few reviewers find the jars too thick, bulky, or heavy for travel.
